‘‘Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattārome samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti. Katame cattāro?
Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṃ pivanti merayaṃ, surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā.
‘‘Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti, methunasmā dhammā appaṭiviratā.
‘‘Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanti, jātarūparajatapaṭiggahaṇā appaṭiviratā.
‘‘Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchājīvena jīvanti, micchājīvā appaṭiviratā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Upakkilesasutta (four stains of ascetics)
quotes.english: Just so, bhikkhus, there are four stains of ascetics and brahmins, stained by which some ascetics and brahmins do not glow, do not shine, do not radiate. What four? Some ascetics and brahmins drink liquor and wine, not refraining from drinking them; some engage in sexual intercourse, not refraining from it; some accept gold and silver, not refraining from accepting it; some make their living by wrong livelihood, not refraining from it.

quotes.pali: ‘‘Etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ rattaññūnaṃ yadidaṃ aññāsikoṇḍañño’’.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Aññāsikoṇḍañña
quotes.english: Monks, the foremost of my monk disciples of long standing is Aññāsikoṇḍañña.

quotes.pali:
… Mahāpaññānaṃ yadidaṃ sāriputto.
… Iddhimantānaṃ yadidaṃ mahāmoggallāno.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Sāriputta & Mahāmoggallāna
quotes.english: …the foremost of those with great wisdom is Sāriputta. …the foremost of those with psychic power is Mahāmoggallāna.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Nābhinandāmi maraṇaṃ,
nābhinandāmi jīvitaṃ;
Kālañca paṭikaṅkhāmi,
nibbisaṃ bhatako yathā.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Sāriputta (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: “I do not long for death; I do not long for life; I await my time, like a worker waiting for wages.”

quotes.pali:
‘‘Āraññikā piṇḍapātikā,
uñchāpattāgate ratā;
Dālemu maccuno senaṃ,
ajjhattaṃ susamāhitā.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Mahāmoggallāna (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: Forest-dwellers, alms-food eaters, delighting in whatever comes into the bowl: let us shatter Death's army, well concentrated within.

quotes.pali: … Dhutavādānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākassapo.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Mahākassapa
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who uphold the ascetic practices is Mahākassapa.

quotes.label: Theragāthā · Mahākassapa (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: Scraps of food for nourishment, fermented urine as medicine, the root of a tree as lodging, rag-robes as clothing: one who has mastered these is truly a man of the four quarters.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahussutānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando’’.
… Satimantānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando.
… Gatimantānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando.
… Dhitimantānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando.
… Upaṭṭhākānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Ānanda
quotes.english: Monks, the foremost of my monk disciples who are learned is Ānanda; …of those with mindfulness, Ānanda; …of those with good conduct of mind (gati), Ānanda; …of the resolute, Ānanda; …of attendants, Ānanda.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Bahussuto dhammadharo,
kosārakkho mahesino;
Cakkhu sabbassa lokassa,
pūjanīyo bahussuto.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Ānanda (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: Learned, bearer of the Dhamma, keeper of the great seer's treasury, an eye for the whole world, the learned one is worthy of honour.

quotes.pali: … Dibbacakkhukānaṃ yadidaṃ anuruddho.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Anuruddha
quotes.english: …the foremost of those with the divine eye is Anuruddha.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Yadā me ahu saṅkappo,
tato uttari desayi;
Nippapañcarato buddho,
nippapañcamadesayi.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Anuruddha (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: When I had that thought, he taught me further: the Buddha, delighting in non-proliferation, taught non-proliferation.

quotes.pali:
… Araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūti.
… Dakkhiṇeyyānaṃ yadidaṃ subhūti.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Subhūti
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who dwell without conflict is Subhūti. …the foremost of those worthy of offerings is Subhūti.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Channā me kuṭikā sukhā nivātā,
vassa deva yathāsukhaṃ;
Cittaṃ me susamāhitaṃ vimuttaṃ,
ātāpī viharāmi vassa devā’’ ti.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Subhūti
quotes.english: My hut is roofed, pleasant, sheltered from the wind: rain as you like, sky-god! My mind is well concentrated and freed; I dwell ardent: rain, sky-god!

quotes.pali: … Vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ upāli.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Upāli
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who uphold the Vinaya is Upāli.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Saddhāya abhinikkhamma,
navapabbajito navo;
Mitte bhajeyya kalyāṇe,
suddhājīve atandite.
‘‘Saddhāya abhinikkhamma,
navapabbajito navo;
Saṅghasmiṃ viharaṃ bhikkhu,
sikkhetha vinayaṃ budho.
‘‘Saddhāya abhinikkhamma,
navapabbajito navo;
Kappākappesu kusalo,
careyya apurakkhato’’ ti.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Upāli
quotes.english: One gone forth in faith, newly ordained, should keep company with good friends, pure in livelihood and untiring. … dwelling in the Saṅgha, the wise monk should train in the Vinaya. … skilled in what is allowable and not, he should live without putting himself forward.

quotes.pali: ‘‘Etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhākāmānaṃ yadidaṃ rāhulo’’.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Rāhula
quotes.english: Monks, the foremost of my monk disciples who desire training is Rāhula.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Ubhayeneva sampanno,
rāhulabhaddoti maṃ vidū;
Yañcamhi putto buddhassa,
yañca dhammesu cakkhumā.
‘‘Yañca me āsavā khīṇā,
yañca natthi punabbhavo;
Arahā dakkhiṇeyyomhi,
tevijjo amataddaso.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Rāhula
quotes.english: Endowed on both sides, they know me as ‘Rāhula the Fortunate’: because I am the Buddha's son, and because I have the eye of Dhamma. Because my taints are destroyed and there is no more renewed existence, I am an arahant worthy of offerings, with the three knowledges, seer of the deathless.

quotes.pali: … Uccākulikānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāyaputto.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Bhaddiya Kāḷigodhāyaputta
quotes.english: …the foremost of those from high families is Bhaddiya, son of Kāḷigodhā.

quotes.pali: ‘‘Pubbe me, bhante, agāriyabhūtassa rajjaṃ kārentassa antopi antepure rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi, bahipi antepure rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi, antopi nagare rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi, bahipi nagare rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi, antopi janapade rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi, bahipi janapade rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi. So kho ahaṃ, bhante, evaṃ rakkhito gopito santo bhīto ubbiggo ussaṅkī utrāsī vihāsiṃ. Etarahi kho panāhaṃ, bhante, araññagatopi rukkhamūlagatopi suññāgāragatopi eko abhīto anubbiggo anussaṅkī anutrāsī appossukko pannalomo paradattavutto, migabhūtena cetasā viharāmi. Imaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno araññagatopi rukkhamūlagatopi suññāgāragatopi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi– ‘aho sukhaṃ, aho sukhan’’’ ti!
quotes.label: Udāna · Bhaddiyasutta · Bhaddiya Kāḷigodhāyaputta
quotes.english: Formerly, venerable sir, when I was a householder ruling a kingdom, there were guards well posted inside and outside the palace, the city and the country. Yet guarded and protected so, I lived fearful, agitated, distrustful and afraid. But now, gone to the forest, to the foot of a tree, to an empty place, I live alone, fearless, unagitated, trusting, unafraid, at ease, unruffled, living on what others give, with a mind like a wild deer. Seeing this benefit I often exclaim: ‘Oh, what happiness! Oh, what happiness!’

quotes.pali:
‘‘Etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminantānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako’’.
… Cetovivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Cūḷapanthaka
quotes.english: Monks, the foremost of my monk disciples who create a mind-made body is Cūḷapanthaka. …the foremost of those skilled in the evolution of mind is Cūḷapanthaka.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Anukampāya me satthā,
pādāsi pādapuñchaniṃ;
‘Etaṃ suddhaṃ adhiṭṭhehi,
ekamantaṃ svadhiṭṭhitaṃ’.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Cūḷapanthaka (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: Out of compassion the Teacher gave me a foot-wiping cloth: ‘Concentrate on this clean thing, fixing your mind well on one side.’

quotes.pali:
‘‘Te me ijjhiṃsu saṅkappā,
yadattho pāvisiṃ kuṭiṃ;
Vijjāvimuttiṃ paccesaṃ,
mānānusayamujjahan’’ ti.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Sīvali
quotes.english: The aims for which I entered the hut have been fulfilled for me. Seeking true knowledge and liberation, I abandoned the underlying tendency to conceit.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Sabbamitto sabbasakho,
sabbabhūtānukampako;
Mettacittañca bhāvemi,
abyāpajjarato sadā.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Khadiravaniya Revata
quotes.english: Friend to all, companion to all, compassionate to all beings, I develop a mind of loving-kindness, always delighting in non-ill-will.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Yassa pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ,
kusalena pidhīyati;
Somaṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti,
abbhā muttova candimā.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Aṅgulimāla (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: Whose evil deed is covered by the good, he lights up this world like the moon freed from a cloud.

quotes.pali: ‘‘Tasmātiha te, bāhiya, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ – ‘diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissatī’ ti.
quotes.label: Udāna · Bāhiyasutta · Bāhiya Dārucīriya (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: “In that case, Bāhiya, you should train yourself thus: ‘In the seen there will be merely the seen; in the heard, merely the heard; in the sensed, merely the sensed; in the cognized, merely the cognized.’

quotes.pali: ‘Upaniyyati loko addhuvo’ ti kho, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena paṭhamo dhammuddeso uddiṭṭho, yamahaṃ ñatvā ca disvā sutvā ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito. ‘Atāṇo loko anabhissaro’ ti kho, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dutiyo dhammuddeso uddiṭṭho, yamahaṃ ñatvā ca disvā sutvā ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito. ‘Assako loko, sabbaṃ pahāya gamanīyan’ ti kho, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena tatiyo dhammuddeso uddiṭṭho, yamahaṃ ñatvā ca disvā sutvā ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito. ‘Ūno loko atitto taṇhādāso’ ti kho, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena catuttho dhammuddeso uddiṭṭho, yamahaṃ ñatvā ca disvā sutvā ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
quotes.label: Majjhima Nikāya · Raṭṭhapālasutta · Raṭṭhapāla (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: The four summaries of the Dhamma taught by the Blessed One, knowing and seeing which Raṭṭhapāla went forth: ‘The world is swept away, it is unstable.’ ‘The world has no shelter and no protector.’ ‘The world has nothing of its own; one must leave all and pass on.’ ‘The world is incomplete, insatiate, the slave of craving.’

quotes.pali:
‘‘Tameva vācaṃ bhāseyya,
yāyattānaṃ na tāpaye;
Pare ca na vihiṃseyya,
sā ve vācā subhāsitā.
quotes.label: Theragāthā · Vaṅgīsa (bhikkhu)
quotes.english: “Speak only such words that do not burn yourself; And do not harm others; that speech is truly well spoken.

quotes.pali: ‘‘Etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ rattaññūnaṃ yadidaṃ mahāpajāpatigotamī’’.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī
quotes.english: Monks, the foremost of my nun disciples of long standing is Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Buddha vīra namo tyatthu,
sabbasattānamuttama;
Yo maṃ dukkhā pamocesi,
aññañca bahukaṃ janaṃ.
quotes.label: Therīgāthā · Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī (bhikkhunī)
quotes.english: Buddha, hero, homage to you, foremost of all beings, who released me from suffering, and many other people too.

quotes.pali: … Mahāpaññānaṃ yadidaṃ khemā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Khemā
quotes.english: …the foremost of those with great wisdom is Khemā.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Iminā pūtikāyena,
āturena pabhaṅgunā;
Aṭṭiyāmi harāyāmi,
kāmataṇhā samūhatā.
quotes.label: Therīgāthā · Khemā (bhikkhunī)
quotes.english: With this foul body, sick and fragile, I am troubled and ashamed; craving for sensual pleasure is uprooted.

quotes.pali: … Iddhimantīnaṃ yadidaṃ uppalavaṇṇā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Uppalavaṇṇā
quotes.english: …the foremost of those with psychic power is Uppalavaṇṇā.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Sataṃ sahassānipi dhuttakānaṃ,
samāgatā edisakā bhaveyyuṃ;
Lomaṃ na iñje napi sampavedhe,
kiṃ me tuvaṃ māra karissaseko.
quotes.label: Therīgāthā · Uppalavaṇṇā (bhikkhunī)
quotes.english: Even if a hundred thousand rogues like you came together here, I would not stir a hair nor tremble. What can you alone do to me, Māra?

quotes.pali: … Vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ paṭācārā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Paṭācārā
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who uphold the Vinaya is Paṭācārā.

quotes.label: Therīgāthā · Paṭācārā (bhikkhunī)
quotes.english: Washing my feet, I watched the water; seeing the foot-water flow from high ground to low, I concentrated my mind as one trains a good thoroughbred horse. Then taking a lamp I entered my dwelling, looked at the bed and sat down on the couch.

quotes.pali: … Dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadinnā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Dhammadinnā
quotes.english: …the foremost of the Dhamma speakers is Dhammadinnā.

quotes.pali: ‘‘‘Sakkāyo sakkāyo’ ti, ayye, vuccati. Katamo nu kho, ayye, sakkāyo vutto bhagavatā’’ ti? ‘‘Pañca kho ime, āvuso visākha, upādānakkhandhā sakkāyo vutto bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ – rūpupādānakkhandho, vedanupādānakkhandho, saññupādānakkhandho, saṅkhārupādānakkhandho, viññāṇupādānakkhandho. Ime kho, āvuso visākha, pañcupādānakkhandhā sakkāyo vutto bhagavatā’’ ti.
quotes.label: Majjhima Nikāya · Cūḷavedallasutta · Dhammadinnā
quotes.english: “‘Identity, identity’ (sakkāya) it is said, lady. What did the Blessed One call identity?” “These five aggregates subject to clinging, friend Visākha, the Blessed One called identity: the form, feeling, perception, formations and consciousness aggregates subject to clinging.”

quotes.pali:
‘‘Chandajātā avasāyī,
manasā ca phuṭā siyā;
Kāmesu appaṭibaddhacittā,
uddhaṃsotāti vuccatī’’ ti.
quotes.label: Therīgāthā · Dhammadinnā
quotes.english: One in whom desire has arisen, who is resolved and pervaded by mind, whose mind is not bound to sense pleasures, is called ‘one going upstream’.

quotes.pali: … Jhāyīnaṃ yadidaṃ nandā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Nandā
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who meditate is Nandā.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Āturaṃ asuciṃ pūtiṃ,
passa nande samussayaṃ;
Asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi,
ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ.
quotes.label: Therīgāthā · Sundarīnandā
quotes.english: Nandā, see this body, sick, impure, putrid; develop the mind on the unattractive, unified and well concentrated.

quotes.pali: … Āraddhavīriyānaṃ yadidaṃ soṇā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Soṇā
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who arouse energy is Soṇā.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Dasa putte vijāyitvā,
asmiṃ rūpasamussaye;
Tatohaṃ dubbalā jiṇṇā,
bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamiṃ.
‘‘Sā me dhammamadesesi,
khandhāyatanadhātuyo;
Tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna,
kese chetvāna pabbajiṃ.
quotes.label: Therīgāthā · Soṇā
quotes.english: Having borne ten sons in this bodily frame, then weak and old I went to a nun. She taught me the Dhamma: aggregates, sense bases and elements. Having heard her Dhamma I cut off my hair and went forth.

quotes.pali: … Lūkhacīvaradharānaṃ yadidaṃ kisāgotamī.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Kisāgotamī
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who wear coarse robes is Kisāgotamī.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Kalyāṇamittatā muninā,
lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā;
Kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno,
api bālo paṇḍito assa.
quotes.label: Therīgāthā · Kisāgotamī (bhikkhunī)
quotes.english: Good friendship has been praised by the Sage with reference to the world; associating with good friends, even a fool would become wise.

quotes.pali: … Dāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ sudatto gahapati anāthapiṇḍiko.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Anāthapiṇḍika
quotes.english: …the foremost of givers is the householder Sudatta Anāthapiṇḍika.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Idañhi taṃ jetavanaṃ,
isisaṅghanisevitaṃ;
Āvutthaṃ dhammarājena,
pītisañjananaṃ mama.
quotes.label: Saṃyutta Nikāya · Anāthapiṇḍikasutta · Anāthapiṇḍika (upāsaka)
quotes.english: This indeed is that Jeta's Grove, frequented by the community of seers, dwelt in by the King of Dhamma: it brings me joy.

quotes.pali: … Dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ citto gahapati macchikāsaṇḍiko.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Citta
quotes.english: …the foremost of the Dhamma speakers is the householder Citta of Macchikāsaṇḍa.

quotes.pali: ‘‘Na khvāhaṃ ettha, bhante, bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi. Atthi avitakko avicāro samādhi, atthi vitakkavicārānaṃ nirodho’’ ti.
quotes.label: Saṃyutta Nikāya · Nigaṇṭhasutta · Citta gahapati (upāsaka)
quotes.english: “Here, venerable sir, I do not go by faith in the Blessed One: there is a concentration without thought and examination; there is a cessation of thought and examination.”

quotes.pali: … Catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi parisaṃ saṅgaṇhantānaṃ yadidaṃ hatthako āḷavako.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Hatthaka
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who hold an assembly together by the four means of sympathy is Hatthaka of Āḷavī.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Sabbadā ve sukhaṃ seti,
brāhmaṇo parinibbuto;
Yo na limpati kāmesu,
sītibhūto nirūpadhi.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Hatthakasutta · Hatthaka Āḷavaka (upāsaka)
quotes.english: Always indeed the brahmin sleeps well, fully quenched, who is not soiled by sensual pleasures, cooled and without acquisitions.

quotes.pali: … Vissāsakānaṃ yadidaṃ nakulapitā gahapatīti.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Nakulapitā
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who are intimate (with the Teacher) is the householder Nakulapitā.

quotes.pali: Tasmātiha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ – ‘āturakāyassa me sato cittaṃ anāturaṃ bhavissatī’ ti.
quotes.label: Saṃyutta Nikāya · Nakulapitusutta · Nakulapitā (upāsaka)
quotes.english: Therefore, householder, you should train yourself thus: ‘Even though I am afflicted in body, my mind will be unafflicted.’

quotes.pali: … Dāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ visākhā migāramātā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Visākhā
quotes.english: …the foremost of givers is Visākhā, Migāra's mother.

quotes.pali: ‘‘Yesaṃ kho, visākhe, sataṃ piyāni, sataṃ tesaṃ dukkhāni; yesaṃ navuti piyāni, navuti tesaṃ dukkhāni;
quotes.label: Udāna · Visākhāsutta · Visākhā (upāsikā)
quotes.english: “Those who have a hundred dear things, Visākhā, have a hundred sufferings; those who have ninety dear things have ninety sufferings.”

quotes.pali: ‘‘Etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṭhamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchantīnaṃ yadidaṃ sujātā seniyadhītā’’.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Sujātā
quotes.english: Monks, the foremost of my laywomen disciples who first went for refuge is Sujātā, Seniya's daughter.

quotes.pali: … Bahussutānaṃ yadidaṃ khujjuttarā.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Khujjuttarā
quotes.english: …the foremost of the learned is Khujjuttarā.

quotes.pali: … Mettāvihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ sāmāvatī.
quotes.label: Aṅguttara Nikāya · Etadaggavagga · Sāmāvatī
quotes.english: …the foremost of those who dwell in loving-kindness is Sāmāvatī.

quotes.pali:
Te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ ti.
quotes.label: Stock phrase · Majjhima Nikāya · Bhayabheravasutta
quotes.english: …with the breakup of the body, after death, they have reappeared in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, the nether world, hell. … with the breakup of the body, after death, they have reappeared in a good destination, a heavenly world.

quotes.pali:
‘‘Aniccā vata saṅkhārā,
uppādavayadhammino;
Uppajjitvā nirujjhanti,
tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho’’ ti.
quotes.label: Dīgha Nikāya · Mahāparinibbānasutta
quotes.english: Impermanent indeed are conditioned things; their nature is to arise and pass away. Having arisen, they cease; their stilling is bliss.

quotes.pali: ‘‘Handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā’’ ti.
quotes.label: Dīgha Nikāya · Mahāparinibbānasutta
quotes.english: “Come now, monks, I tell you: all conditioned things are subject to decay, strive on with heedfulness!”

quotes.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
quotes.label: Stock phrase · Saṃyutta Nikāya · Paṭiccasamuppādasutta
quotes.english: This is what the Blessed One said. Elated, those monks delighted in the Blessed One's words.
